Rebuilt from CURRENT MAIN ot_s81sl_xs as ot_s81sl_xs4 = main x streamer with one capture edge in front (K = 1): 21 kept capture copies per gather control port bit (v / fam / idx per source), one data flop per g_d / is_d bit, 2 is_v copies; level-B = main's pin flops in decoded form: 24 write leaves (8 x 9 kept one-hot data selects of 32 pins, 4 + 4 mask-half copies of 32 pins, w_ce / w_addr, own wpar replicas), arrival-table set one-hots per source in 16-beat blocks, 22 table groups of 8 beats with own parity replica / window clear, block exponents moved from a 3.84 kb flop array to 6 SRAMs (ot_sram_1r1w2c_128x64_m1, per source x beat bit 2); issuer delay line with registered one-hot write enables and 5 one-hot read-pointer copies (own pop compare each), 8 window-open copies; read side from 5 + 1 stream-head copies in the controller, arrival-table lookups by registered factorised one-hot indices, registered one-hot read-mux lines (12 / 24 per 32-b slice) into stage-3 AND-OR; stream-ROM bank one-hot copies; native calendar reader copy (one-hot row pointers, 6 due copies with own pointer / age / active, registered row write enables); native ctl copy (config-tag one-hot, hold-in-reset payload on regional enables, 36 bv copies for the lane word select); lane = dsfd_pq_lx STATIC_X2 function; reset port -> 2 sync -> 4 early / 54 / 4-stage 39 regions, every region <= 26 loads, payload reset-free. xs4_equiv (tools/s81_slice/xs4_equiv.sh, Verilator 5.050): vs main ot_s81sl_xs + one-edge tb relay on every input, xw_v / xw_d / fault every edge: 7 production L0 / L2 programs (near / far / rand ring orders, offsets 29-61), 2 late-beat programs (fault on the same edge), 10 fault injections (duplicate / out-of-range beats, reserved / offset / random issuer words, random gather bursts), 2 in-flight resets with program restart; 6 mutants (bank / off / qswap / wcopy / tpar / exp) FAIL.
